description: Drive to the nearest confirmed person and stop about 1 m short: gap_m 1.1, measured from the car's front to the person's near edge. 1.1 is the closest the loader allows for a person (gap_min 1.07 m = car_radius 0.20 + avoidance_margin 0.12 + person class_margin 0.50 + settle_buffer 0.10 + solver nose 0.15). acquire_timeout_sec 10 gives semantic_layer_node time to confirm the track (3 hits at score >= 0.5) with the person standing in front of the car. Needs /costmap/semantic_tracks and the global EKF.
